messages:
Maya Torres: Quick heads-up: when I opened the vectors preview for a 1.2M-row batch the browser tab spiked and became unresponsive. We shouldn't be hydrating full vectors in the DOM.
Ethan Brooks: Yikes. We should cap preview payload to metadata + a 200-char text snippet + a tiny visualization (sparkline) for similarity. Offer a separate 'Download vectors' flow for the full numeric data.
Priya Singh: UX question: Should the download option be CSV with base64 vectors, or a ZIP containing a CSV + binary .npy/.bin? CSV w/ base64 will bloat and be fragile. ZIP feels more reliable for engineering users.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed on ZIP. Backend can stream a multipart archive. For smaller exports (<10k rows) we can include inline base64 in CSV to keep it simple. We'll need to document size thresholds.
Maya Torres: Copy nit: we currently label the column "relevance" in the table. For clarity across reranking vs semantic search, I'd prefer "rerank score" in reranker flows and "similarity" in raw vector views.
Ethan Brooks: Makes sense. Also add an inline tooltip: "Rerank score — relative ranking from the current model". Keep the column header compact: "Rerank score".
Priya Singh: Accessibility: the relevance badges are colored but don't expose verbatim text to screen readers. Need aria-labels like "Rerank score: 0.82, higher is more relevant" and ensure sortable headers use `aria-sort` updates.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: use <table role="grid"> with proper <th scope> and `aria-live="polite"` for results count updates. Announce export start/completion via an ARIA live region.
Liam O'Connor: UX layout debate: compact table vs card view for vector rows. Cards are better for long metadata, table is denser. Proposal: default to table for batch flows, allow a toggle to card view labeled "Expanded preview".
Maya Torres: For the export modal copy, propose: Primary CTA = "Export selected (ZIP)". Secondary = "Export selected (CSV only)". Helper text: "ZIP contains CSV + vectors.npy when available".
Priya Singh: Also include a tiny checkbox "Include vectors" default OFF for large selections, with helper: "Embeddings can be large; downloading vectors may take significant time."
Ethan Brooks: Implementation note: add job endpoint /exports (POST) that returns a job id. Client polls /exports/:id/status and receives a pre-signed URL when ready. This avoids browser timeouts and keeps memory low.
Maya Torres: UX follow-ups: add an in-table action to "Peek vector" that opens a lightweight modal showing a sparkline + top-5 nearest texts. Should be async and paginated.
Liam O'Connor: Small copy change: change header "Vector dim" -> "Dim" to reduce column width.
Priya Singh: A11y final note: ensure focus lands on the job toast when export starts and that keyboard users can open Downloads panel and get status updates.
a11y-bot: Ticket suggestion: DX-4189 "Batch preview memory & export UX" — include acceptance criteria for aria-live, table role, job endpoint, and export file format docs.
Maya Torres: I'll spin a brief prototype and include the ZIP vs CSV examples in the design ticket. Thanks all for quick input!
